CP2K.PBE0_architecture: ALMO supplies density to common Quickstep KS energy update; common update includes Hartree-Fock exchange. Molecular fragment guesses reuse parent FORCE_EVAL/DFT settings. No categorical ALMO-HFX prohibition found in inspected call path, but combined quartet was not run.

build_requirements.base: Compatible C/C++/Fortran compilers, BLAS/LAPACK, DBCSR, OpenMP and FFT implementation; MPI/ScaLAPACK for an MPI executable. Exact install recipe/version remains root-owned.
build_requirements.hybrid: Enable CP2K_USE_LIBINT2 and provide its Fortran interface; use adequate integral angular-momentum coverage for the actual basis.
build_requirements.no_silent_approximations: Do not substitute GTH/core counts, ADMM, truncated XALMO delocalization or periodic charged reference for the archived vacuum Hamiltonian.
build_requirements.semilocal_integrals: LIBGRPP is bundled unconditionally in src/CMakeLists.txt in v2026.2 and inspected master; preserve ECP_SEMI_LOCAL true.

CP2K.charged_reference_caveat: Official SUBLATTICE documentation says its frozen term lacks interpretation for charged fragments, without a boundary-condition qualification. Source does not force periodicity and provides raw energies without the formal summary; nonperiodic interpretation is a supported candidate route, not a measured validation.

hard_stock_input_blocker.La46: Accepted by this parser switch; does not qualify full La calculation.
hard_stock_input_blocker.scope: Both file and inline ECP routes reach this unconditional default-occupation switch. KIND/ELEC_CONF is applied only after the ECP reader returns, so it cannot bypass the abort. No documented exact-input alternate route was found. This is not an integral-capacity claim.

CP2K.license: Public GPL source; no commercial license purchase/credential requirement identified. No installation was performed.
CP2K.raw_frozen_energy_route: mscfg_methods.F uses parent cell and explicit fragment charge/multiplicity, stores each fragment energy. almo_scf.F assembles fragment MOs, builds nonorthogonal antisymmetrized projector and prints summed fragment energy and initial-guess frozen energy independently of ANALYSIS/SUBLATTICE. FULL_SCF offers full delocalization; default XALMO_X is an approximate correction and cannot be silently substituted.
CP2K.remaining: No executable, build or combined PBE0/custom-ECP55/ALMO result. Stock inspected CP2K cannot currently supply the full exact quartet through its normal ECP reader. No source patch, core replacement or install was made.
